name: Evil Recruit ~Onara de Sekai o Shihaiseyo!~
original_name: イビルリクルート～オナラで世界を支配せよ!～
source:
Sakura Naoi has always struggled with the strong stench of her farts.
She felt at a loss as her smelly farts made it difficult for her to find a job.
However, it was then that she received a letter.

"What is this...? 'Secret Society Asterisk Recruitment Guide' ...?
'Our company is dedicated to dominating the world with farts.' ?"

Secret Society Asterisk.
There, she'll meet people who have the same woes as her.

"Those passengers were so rude...! They were overreacting from just a little fart!"
"Honestly! They're all so pathetic! They're the ones causing trouble!!"

Those who think they're all high and mighty because their farts don't stink would fall to their knees and cry if you farted on them. It's ridiculous how we have to take orders from people like that!"

And that's how Sakura committed herself to a life reeking of farts.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01039895.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“佐仓直井一直在与放屁的强烈恶臭作斗争。
她感到很茫然，因为她的臭屁让她很难找到工作。
然而，就在这时，她收到了一封信。

“这是什么……？‘秘密结社星号招募指南’……？
“我们公司致力于用屁统治世界。”？”

秘密结社星号。
在那里，她会遇到和她有同样烦恼的人。

“那些乘客太粗鲁了……！就一个小屁就反应过度了！”
“说实话！他们都太可怜了！都是他们惹事的！！”

那些因为放屁不臭而自以为高高在上的人，如果你在他们身上放屁，他们会跪下来哭。我们竟然要听从这样的人的命令，真是可笑！”

就这样，小樱决定过上放屁的生活。
